figures._note: Step 3 of the unit, the trap: infinite grid in the field view, Shape size swept from well inside its cell to past its edge and back (the box is 1.18 times size across its half-width, so it outgrows a 0.34 cell at 0.144), so the clip loops. Once the shape outgrows its cell it is chopped square and the isolines break at every cell boundary.
